soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
soundness_flags.one_line: Its fourth-moment envelope, Lindeberg condition, and nondegenerate oracle-risk regime are load-bearing hypotheses but are not formal assumptions or dependencies; promote them to separately tagged assumptions before asking for uniform inference.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2 / maintained structural restrictions
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Unit-specific additive finite distributed lags and exact degree-r unit-specific polynomial untreated paths are maintained restrictions, not consequences of rollout randomization.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The sharp formula T_min(r,L)=max{r+2,L+1) is claimed only conditional on those structural restrictions and irreversible endpoint rollout.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper implements monotone Bernoulli rollout stages using one independent U[0,1] draw per individual and thresholding at each stage; it recovers a degree-beta treatment-fraction response with beta+1 observations and gives variance bounds for the static low-degree interference model.

The paper formulates T-optimal design as maximizing the trace of the GLS precision matrix and gives sufficient optimality conditions under its panel/GLS assumptions; its treated-fraction solution has five temporal phases, including nonlinear transition phases.

The article defines finite-population dynamic causal effects for panel experiments, derives randomization-unbiased estimation and limiting distributions, and supplies conservative weak-null and exact sharp-null inference procedures.

The preprint studies staggered cluster adoption, establishes finite-population consistency and asymptotic normality for regression estimators, and describes covariance estimators as conservative; it is not an oracle-risk-equivalent repeated-hash-threshold result.

The paper derives an efficient estimator within a class nesting generalized difference-in-differences estimators and an asymptotically unbiased feasible plug-in estimator for randomized staggered treatment timing.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add separate formal assumptions for the finite-population fourth-moment envelope, max-unit Lindeberg condition, and nR_Gamma nondegeneracy, with citations or a novel-condition justification; list all three in the OEQ dependencies.

Add a sensitivity corollary quantifying the bias from a bounded (r+1)-st untreated-trend difference or from lag order L+1 leakage, so the exact polynomial and finite-lag restrictions have an operational robustness diagnostic.

Sharpen the inference OEQ into a dichotomy: derive feasible oracle-risk equivalence under an explicit additional learnability condition, or prove an impossibility result under the present arbitrary heterogeneous finite-population class, using ChenLi2025's conservativeness barrier as a comparator.

recommended_next_step: Revise the open inference question to formalize its three asymptotic scope conditions, then advance the sharp-stage frontier unchanged to Stage 0.
